recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-shot portrait of an elderly man in a blue houndstooth blazer against a textured off-white background, framed by bold red display typography at the top and vertically stacked condensed black serif text on the sides.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's head overlaps the bottom edge of the primary red title.
The blue houndstooth pattern provides high-frequency texture against the flat background.
The red title acts as a heavy header, balanced by the vertical text blocks on the left and right.
The subject's hands and cigar create a central focal point just below the face.
coreInvariants: High-contrast red display type with black drop shadow

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium shot, waist-up, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and round glasses serve as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red title, moves down to the face, follows the hands/cigar, then scans the side text blocks.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample off-white space around the head and shoulders to allow for typographic placement.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Flesh tones and the brown of the cigar.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red title; muted, natural saturation in the photographic subject.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold condensed sans-serif for display; ultra-condensed transitional serif for body.
letterConstructionRules: Display type features tight kerning and a hard black drop shadow.
Secondary type is vertically elongated with high stroke contrast.

treatment.shadow: hard black drop shadow offset bottom-right

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact bold sans-serif header paired with elegant, narrow serif sidebars.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, bold display feel of the header.
Matches the ultra-condensed, high-contrast serif style of the side text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of an elderly man with glasses and a cigar, wearing a blue houndstooth blazer, centered against a warm off-white textured background. Leave space at the top and sides for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large red title in a bold condensed sans-serif with a black drop shadow at the top. Add vertically stacked text in an ultra-condensed black serif to the left and right of the subject.

verificationChecks: Is the header red with a black drop shadow?
Is the jacket a blue houndstooth pattern?
Is the side text ultra-condensed and black?
Does the subject's head slightly overlap the header text?

adjustableVariables: Exact shade of red for the title
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original person
The exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Sharp contrast between red text and background

postGenerationChecks: Verify the drop shadow on the red text is sharp and black.
Ensure the houndstooth pattern is clearly visible and not blurred.
Check that the side text is vertically aligned and highly condensed.
Confirm the background is a warm cream/off-white, not pure white.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a centered portrait with high-texture clothing, frame with a heavy condensed header in a primary color, and flank with ultra-narrow serif text blocks to create a classic 1970s-80s album aesthetic.
